title: Combine README techniques around a reader task
summary: Record when complementary README techniques belong together and evaluate whether a reader or agent can complete the intended task at the pinned adopter revision.

origin.source: 2026-11-19 · Owner approved recording reusable technique combinations and piloting one with Veraphify.

benefits: Adopters can apply and adapt proven practices around a concrete task and retain what worked.
risks: A generic checklist can hide which technique applies, and a successful command can be mistaken for a successful reader or agent journey.

evidence.claim: The Veraphify adopter learning log proposes technique combinations by reader task.
The approved trial starts from a draft homepage that publishes the walkthrough and evidence routes.
